topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: I found things up there, hidden away, things no one should ever have left behind. The attic whispers with the remnants of past lives, shadows dancing from the light of my shaking torch. Each item unearthed is a piece of a puzzle I never wanted to solve. Boxes and trinkets, letters yellowed with age, all carrying the weight of forgotten promises and dreams. The air is thick with dust and memories, and I can't help but feel the walls closing in, the silence growing louder. I need to find a way to erase this attic from my house, from my life, but the door that once felt so close now seems impossibly far. Each step back is heavier than the last.
